title: Common vertical vent offset.
officialText:
Where the common vertical vent is offset, the maximum capacity of the common vent
shall be reduced in accordance with Section 504.3.6. The horizontal length of the common vent offset (L ) shall not exceed 1½
o
feet for each inch (18 mm for each 25.4 mm) of common vent diameter (D). Where multiple offsets occur in a common vent,
the total horizontal length of all offsets combined shall not exceed 1½ feet for each inch (18 mm per mm) of common vent
diameter (D).
